title: Nia and the Backward Pajamas
synopsis: A backward pajama top leads to slipper mittens, a very serious teddy bear, and a pretend moon in a pocket.

related_resources.reason: General professional guidance for shared, playful interaction; does not evaluate this bedtime scene.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: Now she had two floppy mittens.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: The joke grows from turning an ordinary household object into something else.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: AAP discusses play with caregivers in general; the slipper-mitten episode is original and no outcome is claimed.

source_note: Original fictional story. Parent-facing references provide context for age-appropriate playful interaction, not direct evidence about this plot or any measured developmental outcome.
